title: Constant-time / timing side-channel review
preconditions: a timing oracle can be measured or inferred
steps: Compile/disassemble at the target optimization level; look for `div`/`idiv`, secret-dependent jumps, and early-exit compares.
Identify which flagged operations actually touch key/nonce/plaintext material; ignore public-only arithmetic.
Replace with constant-time primitives (branchless select, fixed-time compare, precomputed tables) and re-check at more than one opt level/arch.
If measuring, use dudect/ctgrind with many samples; treat small deltas as noise until statistically stable.
falsifier: All secret-dependent operations are branchless/fixed-time and timing variance stays within noise across runs.
